ValidationRule.description: #SFCPQBLG-648 Billing Account Currency should be uneditable after Billing Account Creation. As Per GitLab #23708 Bypassing this validation for NA-SITAD Accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c),CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account'))), RecordType.DeveloperName = $Label.QTB_AccountRecordType_Billing, NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode))), ISCHANGED(CurrencyIsoCode), (NOT((QTB_SITAD__c) && (ISPICKVAL( QTB_Legal_Entity_Country__c , "United States") || ISPICKVAL( QTB_Legal_Entity_Country__c , "Canada") )) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Account Currency can not be modified.
